notes.title: Release 1.2.0.8
notes.content:
Hi There,

thanks to your feedback and contribution, that's outstanding
Now I am ready to ship release 1.2.0.8 including TRADIND CARDS

Release contains
- You needed to escape the message window to terminate the dialogue
- Beam effect only worked with wooden sword
- The skill range didn't apply to enemies
- some minor glitches here and there
- The boring error sound at title screen
- Code now works
And previous release content
ADDED
- Screen resolution increase to 1280x720
- You can now custom your keyboard also for moving keys (left.right, up and down)
- A Strafe mode is added (so you can aim using bows)
- There's a full screen option in the menu
- A new damage pop-up system
- Some swords throw energy like zelda's sword
- If you maintain the strike button....well you'll see 

Good game
Feel free to contact me ! Really !
Geex Games

notes.title: RELEASE 1.2 IS READY WITH MORE FEATURES !
notes.content:
VERSION 1.2

Thanks a lot for your feedback so far
Here are some improvements I've made for release 1.2 :

ADDED
- Screen resolution increase to 1280x720

- You can now custom your keyboard also for moving keys (left.right, up and down)

- A Strafe mode is added (so you can aim using bows)

- There's a full screen option in the menu

- A new damage pop-up system

- Some swords throw energy like zelda's sword

- If you maintain the strike button....well you'll see


FIXED
- A small bug with Music off mode is fixed. Sometimes music replayed despite the music mode was off

- Full action swing animation for swords and bows, spear etc

- A weapon remaining on screen bug is fixed

- When selecting the second weapon or skills, the HUD didn't refresh.

- Mighty energy in the Dungeon was not reachable

- Fullscreen mode crashes

VIDEO

ROUND 1
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QikKuMdY_SE&feature=youtu.be

ROUND 2
https://youtu.be/1wmp9DmzTwg

Feel free to contact me or leave a positive review if you like the game
